meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交或创建PR前需要强制验证测试通过
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce verification before committing or creating PRs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在声称任何任务完成前，必须先运行并确认验证命令（如测试、构建）的输出，否则禁止做出成功声明。
howto.when: 当你要声称工作完成、修复或测试通过，或准备提交、创建PR时触发，必须运行完整的验证命令并确认结果。

say.text: 先跑测试，确认全部通过后再告诉我结果。
say.note: 触发 Claude 运行测试命令并验证输出。

say.text: 你说修复了bug？请运行复现步骤的测试来证明。
say.note: 要求提供实际验证证据。

say.text: 检查构建是否成功，输出退出码给我看。
say.note: 强制 Claude 执行构建并展示结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude must run and confirm verification commands (e.g., tests, build) before claiming any work is complete, fixed, or passing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, or before committing or creating PRs; requires fresh verification evidence.

say_en.text: Run tests and confirm all pass before telling me the result.
say_en.note: Triggers test execution and output verification.

say_en.text: You said the bug is fixed? Run the reproduction test to prove it.
Check build success and show me the exit code.
say_en.note: Forces build command and output display.
